11	/**
12	 * QQ 音乐 QRC 歌词解密器
13	 * 
14	 * 这个解密器实现了 QQ 音乐专有的 QRC 歌词加密算法。
15	 * QQ 音乐的加密流程非常复杂，包含多层编码和解密：
16	 * 
17	 * 加密流程（反向即为解密）：
18	 * 1. 原始歌词文本
19	 * 2. 可能使用 GBK/GB18030 编码（中文歌词）
20	 * 3. Zlib 压缩
21	 * 4. 3DES 加密（非标准实现）
22	 * 5. Hex 编码（十六进制字符串）
23	 * 
24	 * 这个工具与 Unilyric 的非标准 DES 实现对齐，确保兼容性。
25	 */
26	object QqMusicQrcCrypto {
27	    /** DES 加密参数（与非标准实现对齐） */
28	    private const val ROUNDS = 16          // 加密轮数
29	    private const val SUB_KEY_SIZE = 6     // 子密钥大小
30	    private const val DES_BLOCK_SIZE = 8   // DES 块大小（8 字节）
31	
32	    private val codec = QqMusicCodec()     // QQ 音乐专用的编解码器
33	
34	    /**
35	     * 解密 QQ 音乐的 QRC 歌词
36	     * 
37	     * 这是获取 QQ 音乐逐字歌词的核心方法。解密过程非常复杂，需要处理多种情况：
38	     * 
39	     * 主要流程：
40	     * 1. 优先尝试使用 Rust 原生解码器（性能更好，更可靠）
41	     * 2. 如果失败则回退到 Kotlin 实现
42	     * 3. Hex 解码 → 3DES 解密 → Zlib 解压 → UTF-8/GBK 解码
43	     * 4. 特殊处理：Base64 二次解码、BOM 头移除、字符集回退
44	     * 
45	     * @param encryptedText Hex 编码的加密歌词字符串
46	     * @return 解密后的歌词文本
47	     */
48	    fun decryptQrcHex(encryptedText: String): String {
49	        Timber.d("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] Starting Hex+3DES+Zlib decryption, input length: ${encryptedText.length}")
50	        Timber.v("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] Input preview (first 200 chars): ${encryptedText.take(200)}")
51	
52	        // 优先使用 Rust 原生解码器（与上游 Unilyric 逻辑一致，性能更好）
53	        runCatching {
54	            QqMusicQrcNative.decryptQrcHex(encryptedText)
55	        }.getOrNull()?.let { nativeResult ->
56	            if (nativeResult.isNotBlank()) {
57	                Timber.d("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] Decoded using native Rust decoder (length=${nativeResult.length})")
58	                return nativeResult
59	            }
60	        }
61	
62	        Timber.i("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] Native Rust decoder returned empty or failed; falling back to Kotlin implementation")
63	
64	        val encryptedBytes = decodeHex(encryptedText)  // Hex 字符串转字节数组
65	        Timber.d("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] After Hex decode: ${encryptedBytes.size} bytes")
66	        
67	        // 确保数据长度是 DES 块大小的倍数（8 字节）
68	        require(encryptedBytes.size % DES_BLOCK_SIZE == 0) {
69	            "Encrypted data length must be a multiple of $DES_BLOCK_SIZE"
70	        }
71	
72	        /** 逐块进行 3DES 解密 */
73	        val decrypted = ByteArray(encryptedBytes.size)
74	        var offset = 0
75	        while (offset < encryptedBytes.size) {
76	            codec.decryptBlock(encryptedBytes, offset, decrypted, offset)
77	            offset += DES_BLOCK_SIZE
78	        }
79	
80	        Timber.d("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] After 3DES decrypt: ${decrypted.size} bytes, first 32 bytes: ${decrypted.take(32).joinToString(",") { "%02X".format(it) }}")
81	
82	        // 特殊情况处理：某些 QQ 歌词在 3DES 解密后不是 zlib 压缩数据，而是 Base64 或纯文本
83	        // 如果解密后的内容看起来像可打印字符，尝试 Base64 解码
84	        if (looksLikeMostlyPrintable(decrypted)) {
85	            val candidate = String(decrypted, Charsets.UTF_8).trim()
86	            Timber.d("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] Decrypted output looks like text (len=${candidate.length})")
87	            Timber.v("preview=${candidate.take(200)}")
88	            val base64Regex = Regex("^[A-Za-z0-9+/=\\s]+$")
89	            if (candidate.length % 4 == 0 && base64Regex.matches(candidate)) {
90	                try {
91	                    val decoded = Base64.decode(candidate, Base64.DEFAULT)
92	                    val decodedText = String(decoded, Charsets.UTF_8)
93	                    Timber.d("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] Interpreted decrypted output as Base64")
94	                    Timber.v("decoded text preview=${decodedText.take(200)}")
95	                    return decodedText  // Base64 解码成功，直接返回
96	                } catch (e: Exception) {
97	                    Timber.w("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] Base64 decode of decrypted content failed $e")
98	                }
99	            }
100	        }
101	
102	        val decompressed = if (decrypted.isNotEmpty() && decrypted[0] != 0x78.toByte()) {
103	            Timber.i("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] First byte is 0x${"%02X".format(decrypted[0])} (not 0x78), attempting to locate zlib header")
104	            attemptDecompressFromPossibleZlibOffset(decrypted)
105	        } else {
106	            decompress(decrypted)
107	        }
108	        Timber.d("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] After Zlib decompress: ${decompressed.size} bytes")
109	        Timber.v("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] Decompressed preview (first 200 chars): ${String(decompressed.take(200).toByteArray(), Charsets.UTF_8)}")
110	        
111	        val payload = if (
112	            decompressed.size >= 3 &&
113	            decompressed[0] == 0xEF.toByte() &&
114	            decompressed[1] == 0xBB.toByte() &&
115	            decompressed[2] == 0xBF.toByte()
116	        ) {
117	            Timber.d("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] UTF-8 BOM detected, removing first 3 bytes")
118	            decompressed.copyOfRange(3, decompressed.size)
119	        } else {
120	            decompressed
121	        }
122	
123	        val utf8Result = payload.toString(Charsets.UTF_8)
124	
125	        // If UTF-8 decoding produces replacement characters, QQ may be using a different legacy
126	        // encoding (e.g. GBK/GB18030). In that case, attempt a fallback decode.
127	        if (utf8Result.contains('\uFFFD')) {
128	            Timber.i("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] UTF-8 decoding produced replacement chars; retrying with GB18030")
129	            try {
130	                val gb18030 = payload.toString(Charset.forName("GB18030"))
131	                Timber.d("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] Final result length (GB18030): ${gb18030.length}")
132	                Timber.v("preview (first 300 chars): ${gb18030.take(300)}")
133	                return gb18030
134	            } catch (e: Exception) {
135	                Timber.i("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] GB18030 decode failed; falling back to UTF-8 $e")
136	            }
137	        }
138	
139	        Timber.d("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] Final result length: ${utf8Result.length}")
140	        Timber.v("preview (first 300 chars): ${utf8Result.take(300)}")
141	        return utf8Result
142	    }

144	    private fun decodeHex(value: String): ByteArray {
145	        val clean = value.trim()
146	        require(clean.length % 2 == 0) { "Invalid hex string length" }
147	        val out = ByteArray(clean.length / 2)
148	        var i = 0
149	        while (i < clean.length) {
150	            val hi = clean[i].digitToIntOrNull(16) ?: error("Invalid hex string")
151	            val lo = clean[i + 1].digitToIntOrNull(16) ?: error("Invalid hex string")
152	            out[i / 2] = ((hi shl 4) or lo).toByte()
153	            i += 2
154	        }
155	        return out
156	    }
157	
158	    private fun decompress(data: ByteArray): ByteArray {
159	        return try {
160	            InflaterInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(data)).use { it.readBytes() }
161	        } catch (e: Exception) {
162	            Timber.i("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] Zlib decompression failed, retrying as raw deflate $e")
163	            /** Some QQ QRC payloads appear to be raw DEFLATE without zlib headers. */
164	            val inflater = Inflater(true)
165	            try {
166	                InflaterInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(data), inflater).use { it.readBytes() }
167	            } finally {
168	                inflater.end()
169	            }
170	        }
171	    }
172	
173	    private fun looksLikeMostlyPrintable(bytes: ByteArray): Boolean {
174	        if (bytes.isEmpty()) return false
175	        val printable = bytes.count { b ->
176	            val c = b.toInt() and 0xFF
177	            (c in 0x20..0x7E) || c == 0x0A || c == 0x0D || c == 0x09
178	        }
179	        return printable.toDouble() / bytes.size >= 0.75
180	    }
181	
182	    private fun attemptDecompressFromPossibleZlibOffset(data: ByteArray): ByteArray {
183	        /**
184	         * zlib header validity check: (CMF*256 + FLG) % 31 == 0
185	         * CMF is fixed to 0x78 for deflate, but FLG varies.
186	         */
187	        val candidateOffsets = data.withIndex().filter { it.value == 0x78.toByte() }.map { it.index }
188	        Timber.d("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] Found ${candidateOffsets.size} potential 0x78 zlib start bytes")
189	
190	        for (offset in candidateOffsets) {
191	            if (offset + 1 >= data.size) continue
192	            val second = data[offset + 1].toInt() and 0xFF
193	            val combined = (0x78 shl 8) or second
194	            val valid = combined % 31 == 0
195	            Timber.d("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] Candidate @ $offset: header=0x78 0x${"%02X".format(second)} valid=$valid")
196	            if (!valid) continue
197	        
198	            try {
199	                Timber.d("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] Attempt decompress at offset $offset (header=0x78 0x${"%02X".format(second)})")
200	                return decompress(data.copyOfRange(offset, data.size))
201	            } catch (e: Exception) {
202	                Timber.w("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] Decompress attempt failed at offset $offset $e")
203	            }
204	        }
205	
206	        // As a last resort, try decompress from the very start using raw deflate
207	        Timber.i("[QqMusicQrcCrypto] No valid zlib header found; falling back to raw deflate from start")
208	        val inflater = Inflater(true)
209	        return try {
210	            InflaterInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(data), inflater).use { it.readBytes() }
211	        } finally {
212	            inflater.end()
213	        }
214	    }

312	        fun keySchedule(key: ByteArray, mode: Mode): Array<ByteArray> {
313	            val keyRndShift = intArrayOf(1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1)
314	            val keyPermC = intArrayOf(
315	                56, 48, 40, 32, 24, 16, 8,
316	                0, 57, 49, 41, 33, 25, 17,
317	                9, 1, 58, 50, 42, 34, 26,
318	                18, 10, 2, 59, 51, 43, 35
319	            )
320	            val keyPermD = intArrayOf(
321	                62, 54, 46, 38, 30, 22, 14,
322	                6, 61, 53, 45, 37, 29, 21,
323	                13, 5, 60, 52, 44, 36, 28,
324	                20, 12, 4, 27, 19, 11, 3
325	            )
326	            val keyCompression = intArrayOf(
327	                13, 16, 10, 23, 0, 4, 2, 27,
328	                14, 5, 20, 9, 22, 18, 11, 3,
329	                25, 7, 15, 6, 26, 19, 12, 1,
330	                40, 51, 30, 36, 46, 54, 29, 39,
331	                50, 44, 32, 47, 43, 48, 38, 55,
332	                33, 52, 45, 41, 49, 35, 28, 31
333	            )
334	
335	            require(key.size == 8) { "DES key must be 8 bytes" }
336	            val schedule = Array(ROUNDS) { ByteArray(SUB_KEY_SIZE) }
337	
338	            val c0 = permuteFromKeyBytes(key, keyPermC)
339	            val d0 = permuteFromKeyBytes(key, keyPermD)
340	            var c = (c0.toInt() shl 4)
341	            var d = (d0.toInt() shl 4)
342	
343	            keyRndShift.forEachIndexed { i, shift ->
344	                c = rotateLeft28bitInU32(c, shift)
345	                d = rotateLeft28bitInU32(d, shift)
346	                val toGen = if (mode == Mode.Decrypt) 15 - i else i
347	
348	                var subkey48 = 0L
349	                keyCompression.forEachIndexed { k, pos ->
350	                    val bit = if (pos < 28) {
351	                        (c ushr (31 - pos)) and 1
352	                    } else {
353	                        (d ushr (31 - (pos - 27))) and 1
354	                    }
355	                    if (bit != 0) {
356	                        subkey48 = subkey48 or (1L shl (47 - k))
357	                    }
358	                }
359	
360	                val bytes = longToBytesBE(subkey48)
361	                bytes.copyInto(schedule[toGen], 0, 2, 8)
362	            }
363	
364	            return schedule
365	        }

367	        fun desCrypt(input: ByteArray, output: ByteArray, key: Array<ByteArray>, outputOffset: Int = 0) {
368	            val state = IntArray(2)
369	            initialPermutation(state, input)
370	
371	            for (roundKey in key.take(15)) {
372	                val prevRight = state[1]
373	                val prevLeft = state[0]
374	                state[1] = prevLeft xor fFunction(prevRight, roundKey)
375	                state[0] = prevRight
376	            }
377	
378	            state[0] = state[0] xor fFunction(state[1], key[15])
379	            inversePermutation(state, output, outputOffset)
380	        }
381	
382	        private fun fFunction(state: Int, key: ByteArray): Int {
383	            val expanded = applyEBoxPermutation(state)
384	            val key64 = bytesToLongBE(byteArrayOf(0, 0) + key)
385	            val xor = expanded xor key64
386	           
387	            /**
388	             * QQ Music 使用自定义的 S-Box 索引计算（非标准 DES）
389	             * 索引计算：((a & 0x20) | ((a & 0x1f) >> 1) | ((a & 0x01) << 4))
390	             */
391	            fun calculateSBoxIndex(value: Long): Int {
392	                val a = value.toInt()
393	                return ((a and 0x20) or ((a and 0x1f) shr 1) or ((a and 0x01) shl 4))
394	            }
395	            
396	            return SP_TABLES[0][calculateSBoxIndex(xor ushr 42)] or
397	                SP_TABLES[1][calculateSBoxIndex(xor ushr 36)] or
398	                SP_TABLES[2][calculateSBoxIndex(xor ushr 30)] or
399	                SP_TABLES[3][calculateSBoxIndex(xor ushr 24)] or
400	                SP_TABLES[4][calculateSBoxIndex(xor ushr 18)] or
401	                SP_TABLES[5][calculateSBoxIndex(xor ushr 12)] or
402	                SP_TABLES[6][calculateSBoxIndex(xor ushr 6)] or
403	                SP_TABLES[7][calculateSBoxIndex(xor and 0x3F)]
404	        }
405	
406	        private fun initialPermutation(state: IntArray, input: ByteArray) {
407	            state[0] = 0
408	            state[1] = 0
409	            TABLES.ipTable.forEachIndexed { i, tSlice ->
410	                val lookup = tSlice[input[i].toInt() and 0xFF]
411	                state[0] = state[0] or lookup.first
412	                state[1] = state[1] or lookup.second
413	            }
414	        }
415	
416	        private fun inversePermutation(state: IntArray, output: ByteArray, outputOffset: Int) {
417	            val stateU64 = ((state[0].toLong() and 0xFFFF_FFFFL) shl 32) or
418	                (state[1].toLong() and 0xFFFF_FFFFL)
419	            val stateBytes = longToBytesBE(stateU64)
420	            var result = 0L
421	            stateBytes.forEachIndexed { i, b ->
422	                result = result or TABLES.invIpTable[i][b.toInt() and 0xFF]
423	            }
424	            longToBytesBE(result).copyInto(output, outputOffset)
425	        }

427	        private fun generateSpTables(): Array<IntArray> {
428	            return Array(8) { sBoxIdx ->
429	                IntArray(64) { sBoxInput ->
430	                    val sBoxIndex = calculateSboxIndex(sBoxInput)
431	                    val fourBitOutput = S_BOXES[sBoxIdx][sBoxIndex]
432	                    val preP = fourBitOutput shl (28 - (sBoxIdx * 4))
433	                    applyQqPboxPermutation(preP)
434	                }
435	            }
436	        }

438	        private fun applyQqPboxPermutation(input: Int): Int {
439	            val sourceBits = IntArray(32) { i -> (input ushr (31 - i)) and 1 }
440	            val destBits = IntArray(32) { idx -> sourceBits[P_BOX[idx] - 1] }
441	            var output = 0
442	            destBits.forEachIndexed { i, bit ->
443	                output = output or (bit shl (31 - i))
444	            }
445	            return output
446	        }
447	
448	        private fun calculateSboxIndex(a: Int): Int {
449	            return (a and 0x20) or ((a and 0x1F) ushr 1) or ((a and 0x01) shl 4)
450	        }
451	
452	        private fun rotateLeft28bitInU32(value: Int, amount: Int): Int {
453	            val bits28Mask = 0xFFFF_FFF0.toInt()
454	            return ((value shl amount) or (value ushr (28 - amount))) and bits28Mask
455	        }

457	        private fun permuteFromKeyBytes(key: ByteArray, table: IntArray): Long {
458	            val word1 = u32FromLe(key, 0)
459	            val word2 = u32FromLe(key, 4)
460	            val composed = ((word1.toLong() and 0xFFFF_FFFFL) shl 32) or (word2.toLong() and 0xFFFF_FFFFL)
461	            var output = 0L
462	            val outputLen = table.size
463	            table.forEachIndexed { i, pos ->
464	                val bit = (composed ushr (63 - pos)) and 1L
465	                if (bit != 0L) {
466	                    output = output or (1L shl (outputLen - 1 - i))
467	                }
468	            }
469	            return output
470	        }
471	
472	        private fun applyEBoxPermutation(input: Int): Long {
473	            var output = 0L
474	            E_BOX_TABLE.forEachIndexed { i, sourceBitPos ->
475	                val shift = 32 - sourceBitPos
476	                val bit = (input ushr shift) and 1
477	                output = output or (bit.toLong() shl (47 - i))
478	            }
479	            return output
480	        }

482	        private class DesPermutationTables {
483	            val ipTable: Array<Array<Pair<Int, Int>>> = Array(8) { Array(256) { 0 to 0 } }
484	            val invIpTable: Array<LongArray> = Array(8) { LongArray(256) }
485	
486	            init {
487	                val ipRule = intArrayOf(
488	                    34, 42, 50, 58, 2, 10, 18, 26,
489	                    36, 44, 52, 60, 4, 12, 20, 28,
490	                    38, 46, 54, 62, 6, 14, 22, 30,
491	                    40, 48, 56, 64, 8, 16, 24, 32,
492	                    33, 41, 49, 57, 1, 9, 17, 25,
493	                    35, 43, 51, 59, 3, 11, 19, 27,
494	                    37, 45, 53, 61, 5, 13, 21, 29,
495	                    39, 47, 55, 63, 7, 15, 23, 31
496	                )
497	                val invIpRule = intArrayOf(
498	                    37, 5, 45, 13, 53, 21, 61, 29,
499	                    38, 6, 46, 14, 54, 22, 62, 30,
500	                    39, 7, 47, 15, 55, 23, 63, 31,
501	                    40, 8, 48, 16, 56, 24, 64, 32,
502	                    33, 1, 41, 9, 49, 17, 57, 25,
503	                    34, 2, 42, 10, 50, 18, 58, 26,
504	                    35, 3, 43, 11, 51, 19, 59, 27,
505	                    36, 4, 44, 12, 52, 20, 60, 28
506	                )
507	
508	                val input = ByteArray(8)
509	                for (bytePos in 0 until 8) {
510	                    for (byteVal in 0 until 256) {
511	                        input.fill(0)
512	                        input[bytePos] = byteVal.toByte()
513	                        val permuted = applyPermutation(input, ipRule)
514	                        val hi = (permuted ushr 32).toInt()
515	                        val lo = permuted.toInt()
516	                        ipTable[bytePos][byteVal] = hi to lo
517	                    }
518	                }
519	
520	                for (blockPos in 0 until 8) {
521	                    for (blockVal in 0 until 256) {
522	                        val tempInput = (blockVal.toLong() shl (56 - (blockPos * 8)))
523	                        val permuted = applyPermutation(longToBytesBE(tempInput), invIpRule)
524	                        invIpTable[blockPos][blockVal] = permuted
525	                    }
526	                }
527	            }
528	
529	            private fun applyPermutation(input: ByteArray, rule: IntArray): Long {
530	                val normalized = bytesToLongBE(input)
531	                var result = 0L
532	                rule.forEachIndexed { i, srcBitPosFrom1 ->
533	                    val srcBitPos = srcBitPosFrom1 - 1
534	                    val bit = (normalized ushr (63 - srcBitPos)) and 1L
535	                    result = result or (bit shl (63 - i))
536	                }
537	                return result
538	            }
539	        }

541	        private fun u32FromLe(bytes: ByteArray, offset: Int): Int {
542	            return (bytes[offset].toInt() and 0xFF) or
543	                ((bytes[offset + 1].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
544	                ((bytes[offset + 2].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 16) or
545	                ((bytes[offset + 3].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 24)
546	        }
547	
548	        private fun bytesToLongBE(bytes: ByteArray): Long {
549	            var value = 0L
550	            for (b in bytes) {
551	                value = (value shl 8) or (b.toLong() and 0xFF)
552	            }
553	            return value
554	        }
555	
556	        private fun longToBytesBE(value: Long): ByteArray {
557	            val out = ByteArray(8)
558	            for (i in 0 until 8) {
559	                out[7 - i] = ((value ushr (8 * i)) and 0xFF).toByte()
560	            }
561	            return out
562	        }
563	    }

8	/**
9	 * QQ 音乐 QRC 格式解析器（逐字歌词格式）
10	 * 
11	 * QRC 是 QQ 音乐的专有歌词格式，支持逐字精确时间戳。
12	 * 
13	 * 格式特点：
14	 * - 行级时间戳：[起始时间，持续时间]（单位：毫秒）
15	 * - 逐字时间戳：文本 (起始时间，持续时间)
16	 * - 可能包含 XML 包装（需要从 XML 属性中提取）
17	 * 
18	 * 示例：
19	 * [0,5000] 你 (0,500) 好 (500,500) 世 (1000,500) 界 (1500,500)
20	 * 表示：整行从 0ms 开始持续 5000ms，其中"你"从 0ms 开始持续 500ms，依此类推
21	 */
22	object QrcParser {
23	
24	    /**
25	     * 正则表达式：匹配 QRC 逐字令牌
26	     * 分组：text=歌词文本，start=开始时间，duration=持续时间
27	     * 例如："你好 (0,500)" -> text="你好", start=0, duration=500
28	     */
29	    private val lyricTokenRegex = Regex("""(?<text>.*?)\((?<start>\d+),(?<duration>\d+)\)""")
30	    
31	    /**
32	     * 正则表达式：匹配 QRC 行级时间戳
33	     * 格式：[起始时间，持续时间]
34	     */
35	    private val qrcLineTimestampRegex = Regex("""^\[(\d+),(\d+)]""")
36	
37	    /**
38	     * 解析 QRC 格式内容
39	     * 
40	     * 解析流程：
41	     * 1. 如果内容是 XML 格式，先提取 LyricContent 属性值
42	     * 2. 逐行解析，识别行级时间戳和逐字时间戳
43	     * 3. 构建 LyricLine 对象列表
44	     * 
45	     * @param content QRC 格式的完整歌词文本（可能是 XML 包装的）
46	     * @return 解析后的 LyricLine 列表
47	     */
48	    fun parse(content: String): List<LyricLine> {
49	        /** 如果是 XML 格式，需要先提取歌词内容 */
50	        val rawContent = extractQrcFromXmlIfNeeded(content)
51	
52	        // 调试日志：输出原始内容的基本信息
53	        Timber.d("[QrcParser] Raw content length=${rawContent.length}, lineCount=${rawContent.lines().size}, containsNewline=${rawContent.contains('\n')}")
54	        rawContent.lines().take(10).forEachIndexed { index, line ->
55	            Timber.d("[QrcParser] Raw line $index: ${line.take(200)}")
56	        }
57	
58	        val finalLines = mutableListOf<LyricLine>()
59	        mutableMapOf<String, MutableList<String>>()
60	
61	        // 逐行解析
62	        for (raw in rawContent.lines()) {
63	            val line = raw.trim()
64	            if (line.isEmpty()) continue
65	            // 使用统一的元数据检测函数
66	            // TEMPORARILY DISABLED: MetadataStripper.isMetadataLine(line)
67	            // if (MetadataStripper.isMetadataLine(line)) continue
68	
69	            // 解析单行并添加到结果列表
70	            parseSingleLine(line)?.let { finalLines.add(it) }
71	        }
72	
73	        /** 调试输出：统计解析结果 */
74	        val totalWords = finalLines.sumOf { it.words.size }
75	        Timber.d("[QrcParser] Output: ${finalLines.size} lines, $totalWords words (avg=${if (finalLines.isNotEmpty()) totalWords.toDouble() / finalLines.size else 0.0})")
76	
77	        return finalLines
78	    }
79	
80	    /**
81	     * 解析单个 QRC 行
82	     * 
83	     * QRC 行格式：[起始时间，持续时间] 文本 (起始时间，持续时间) 文本 (起始时间，持续时间)...
84	     * 
85	     * 处理逻辑：
86	     * 1. 提取行级时间戳（如果有）
87	     * 2. 逐个提取逐字令牌（文本 + 时间戳）
88	     * 3. 如果没有逐字时间戳但有行级时间戳，使用 fallback 模式
89	     * 4. 构建 LyricLine 对象
90	     * 
91	     * @param line 单行 QRC 歌词文本
92	     * @return 解析后的 LyricLine，如果无法解析则返回 null
93	     */
94	    private fun parseSingleLine(line: String): LyricLine? {
95	        /** QRC 行头部：[lineStart,lineDuration] (单位：毫秒) */
96	        val lineStartMs = qrcLineTimestampRegex.find(line)?.groups?.get(1)?.value?.toLongOrNull()
97	        val lineDurationMs = qrcLineTimestampRegex.find(line)?.groups?.get(2)?.value?.toLongOrNull()
98	    
99	        /** 移除行级时间戳，剩下的就是歌词内容 */
100	        val lineContent = qrcLineTimestampRegex.replace(line, "")
101	        val words = mutableListOf<LyricWord>()
102	    
103	        // 逐个匹配逐字令牌
104	        for (capture in lyricTokenRegex.findAll(lineContent)) {
105	            val rawText = capture.groups["text"]?.value.orEmpty()
106	            val processed = processSyllableText(rawText, words) ?: continue
107	            val (cleanText, endsWithSpace) = processed
108	    
109	            val startMs = capture.groups["start"]?.value?.toLongOrNull() ?: continue
110	            val durationMs = capture.groups["duration"]?.value?.toLongOrNull() ?: continue
111	    
112	            /** 根据是否有尾随空格决定是否在单词后添加空格 */
113	            val text = if (endsWithSpace) "$cleanText " else cleanText
114	            words.add(
115	                LyricWord(
116	                    word = text,
117	                    startTime = startMs,
118	                    endTime = startMs + maxOf(1L, durationMs) // 确保持续时间至少为 1ms，防止 JS 侧计算 NaN
119	                )
120	            )
121	        }
122	
123	        // Fallback 模式：处理只有行级时间戳而没有逐字时间戳的情况
124	        // Some QRC lines include only a line-level timestamp ([start,duration]) without per-word timings.
125	        // In that case, we still want to emit a lyric line rather than drop it.
126	        // However, some files may include placeholder tokens like "(240410,1651)" where there is no actual lyric text.
127	        // Do not treat these timestamp tokens as lyric text.
128	        if (words.isEmpty() && lineStartMs != null) {
129	            val fallbackText = lineContent.trim()
130	            /**
131	             * Normalize to catch hidden/zero-width characters or other noise that still renders as
132	             * a timestamp-like token (e.g. "\u200B(240410,1651)").
133	             */
134	            val normalized = fallbackText.replace(Regex("[^\\d(),]"), "")
135	            val isTimestampToken = Regex("^\\(\\d+,\\d+\\)(?:\\(\\d+,\\d+\\))*$").matches(normalized)
136	            
137	            // 如果不是纯时间戳占位符，就作为整行歌词处理
138	            if (fallbackText.isNotEmpty() && !isTimestampToken) {
139	                val lineEnd = lineStartMs + (lineDurationMs ?: 0)
140	                words.add(
141	                    LyricWord(
142	                        word = fallbackText,
143	                        startTime = lineStartMs,
144	                        endTime = maxOf(lineStartMs + 1, lineEnd) // 确保持续时间至少为 1ms
145	                    )
146	                )
147	            }
148	        }
149	
150	        // 如果没有解析出任何单词，返回 null（丢弃这一行）
151	        if (words.isEmpty()) return null
152	
153	        /**
154	         * 计算行的开始和结束时间
155	         * 优先使用行级时间戳，如果没有则使用第一个和最后一个单词的时间
156	         */
157	        val lineStart = lineStartMs ?: words.first().startTime
158	        val rawLineEnd = lineStart + (lineDurationMs ?: (words.last().endTime - lineStart))
159	        val lineEnd = maxOf(lineStart + 1, rawLineEnd) // 确保行持续时间至少为 1ms
160	
161	        // 创建 LyricLine 对象
162	        return LyricLine(
163	            startTime = lineStart,
164	            endTime = lineEnd,
165	            text = words.joinToString(separator = "") { it.word }.trimEnd(),  // 拼接所有单词
166	            words = words
167	        )
168	    }

170	    /**
171	     * 从 XML 包装中提取 QRC 歌词内容
172	     * 
173	     * QQ 音乐的 QRC 输出有时会被包装在 XML 标签中，例如：
174	     * <Lyric_1 LyricContent="歌词内容..." />
175	     * 
176	     * 由于 XML 解析器会规范化空白字符（换行符变成空格），
177	     * 我们使用正则表达式直接提取属性值，保留原始换行符。

180	     * @return 提取后的纯 QRC 歌词文本
181	     */
182	    private fun extractQrcFromXmlIfNeeded(content: String): String {
183	        // 如果不包含 XML 特征标记，直接返回原始内容
184	        if (!content.contains("<QrcInfos", ignoreCase = true) &&
185	            !content.contains("<LyricInfo", ignoreCase = true) &&
186	            !Regex("""<Lyric_\d+\b""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE).containsMatchIn(content)
187	        ) {
188	            return content
189	        }

191	        // QQ QRC output uses LyricContent="..." attributes, and XML parsers normalize whitespace
192	        // (newlines become spaces), which breaks line splitting. We prefer regex extraction to
193	        // preserve original newlines.
194	        //
195	        // Note: QRC payloads often wrap LyricContent in double quotes, but the lyric text may
196	        // contain apostrophes or even internal quotation marks. We want to use the outermost
197	        // quotes for the attribute value so that inner quotes don't truncate the match.
198	        val extracted = mutableListOf<String>()
199	        /** 匹配 <Lyric_N LyricContent='...' /> 或 <Lyric_N LyricContent="..." /> */
200	        val tagStartRegex = Regex("""<Lyric_\d+\b[^>]*\bLyricContent=(['"])""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
201	        var searchIndex = 0
202	
203	        // 循环查找所有 LyricContent 属性
204	        while (true) {
205	            val match = tagStartRegex.find(content, startIndex = searchIndex) ?: break
206	            val quoteChar = match.groupValues[1].single()  // 获取引号类型（单引号或双引号）
207	            val valueStart = match.range.last + 1  // 属性值开始位置
208	
209	            /** Find the end of the current tag so we can pick the outermost closing quote inside it. */
210	            val tagEnd = content.indexOf('>', startIndex = valueStart).takeIf { it >= 0 } ?: content.length
211	            val lastQuoteBeforeTagEnd = content.lastIndexOf(quoteChar, startIndex = tagEnd - 1)
212	            val valueEnd = if (lastQuoteBeforeTagEnd >= valueStart) {
213	                lastQuoteBeforeTagEnd
214	            } else {
215	                // Fallback: find the first quote after the start
216	                content.indexOf(quoteChar, startIndex = valueStart).takeIf { it >= 0 } ?: content.length
217	            }
218	
219	            /** 提取属性值并进行 XML 反转义 */
220	            val rawValue = content.substring(valueStart, valueEnd)
221	            extracted.add(unescapeXmlAttribute(rawValue))
222	
223	            searchIndex = valueEnd + 1
224	        }
225	
226	        // 如果成功提取了内容，用换行符拼接并返回
227	        if (extracted.isNotEmpty()) {
228	            Timber.d("[QrcParser] Extracted $extracted.size LyricContent entries from QRC XML (regex): ${extracted.joinToString("\\n").take(500)}")
229	            return extracted.joinToString(separator = "\n")
230	        }
231	
232	        // Fallback to DOM parsing if regex failed (very rare)
233	        // 如果正则表达式失败（极罕见），使用 DOM 解析器
234	        return try {
235	            val builder = javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance().newDocumentBuilder()
236	            val doc = builder.parse(content.byteInputStream())
237	            val lyricContents = mutableListOf<String>()
238	
239	            val allElements = doc.getElementsByTagName("*")
240	            for (i in 0 until allElements.length) {
241	                val node = allElements.item(i)
242	                if (node is org.w3c.dom.Element) {
243	                    val lyricContent = node.getAttribute("LyricContent")
244	                    if (!lyricContent.isNullOrBlank()) {
245	                        lyricContents.add(lyricContent)
246	                    }
247	                }
248	            }
249	
250	            if (lyricContents.isEmpty()) {
251	                Timber.d("[QrcParser] Detected QRC XML but no LyricContent attributes found; falling back to raw content")
252	                return content
253	            }
254	            
255	            Timber.d("[QrcParser] Extracted $lyricContents.size LyricContent entries from QRC XML (DOM)")
256	            lyricContents.joinToString(separator = "\n")
257	        } catch (e: Exception) {
258	            Timber.w("[QrcParser] Failed to parse QRC XML content; falling back to raw content $e")
259	            content
260	        }
261	    }
262	
263	    /**
264	     * XML 属性反转移函数
265	     * 
266	     * 将 XML 实体引用转换回原始字符：
267	     * - " -> "
268	     * - ' -> '
269	     * - < -> <
270	     * - > -> >
271	     * - & -> &
272	     * - &#数字; -> Unicode 字符（十进制）
273	     * - &#x 十六进制; -> Unicode 字符（十六进制）
274	     * 
275	     * @param value 包含 XML 实体的字符串
276	     * @return 反转义后的字符串
277	     */
278	    private fun unescapeXmlAttribute(value: String): String {
279	        return value
280	            .replace(""", "\"")      // 双引号
281	            .replace("'", "'")       // 单引号
282	            .replace("<", "<")         // 小于号
283	            .replace(">", ">")         // 大于号
284	            .replace("&", "&")        // 和号（必须最后处理）
285	            .replace(Regex("&#(\\d+);")) { match ->
286	                // 十进制 Unicode 字符引用
287	                match.groups[1]?.value?.toIntOrNull()?.toChar()?.toString() ?: match.value
288	            }
289	            .replace(Regex("&#x([0-9A-Fa-f]+);")) { match ->
290	                // 十六进制 Unicode 字符引用
291	                match.groups[1]?.value?.toIntOrNull(16)?.toChar()?.toString() ?: match.value
292	            }
293	    }
294	}

Key points about the QQ DES/QRC implementation:
- 3DES-EDE mode: Decrypt(KEY3) → Encrypt(KEY2) → Decrypt(KEY1)
- Keys: "!@#)(*$%", "123ZXC!@", "!@#)(NHL" (ASCII bytes)
- Custom S-Box index: ((a & 0x20) | ((a & 0x1f) >> 1) | ((a & 0x01) << 4))
- Custom IP table (initial permutation)
- 16 rounds with custom key rotation schedule
- After 3DES: 15 rounds for the first pass, then one more f-function for the last round (this matches the `desCrypt` function's logic)

Wait, I need to re-read the desCrypt function carefully:

```kotlin
fun desCrypt(input: ByteArray, output: ByteArray, key: Array<ByteArray>, outputOffset: Int = 0) {
    val state = IntArray(2)
    initialPermutation(state, input)

    for (roundKey in key.take(15)) {
        val prevRight = state[1]
        val prevLeft = state[0]
        state[1] = prevLeft xor fFunction(prevRight, roundKey)
        state[0] = prevRight
    }

    state[0] = state[0] xor fFunction(state[1], key[15])
    inversePermutation(state, output, outputOffset)
}
```

This is standard DES Feistel network:
- Performs 15 rounds with full swap
- On the 16th round, no swap (only left = left XOR f(right, key[15]))
- Then final inverse permutation

This looks like standard DES for decryption (where the last round doesn't swap). In standard DES encryption, the last round also doesn't swap after the f-function. So this is a proper DES implementation.

# QQ Music QRC Lyrics Response Models — Analysis

## Overview

This module defines Pydantic response models for the Lyric API, handling various types of lyrics content (original, translated, romaji, and singing annotations) along with AI dictionary features. All models inherit from a shared `Response` base class (imported from `../request`).

---

## Core Models and Their Roles

### `GetLyricResponse` — The Main Lyrics Response

This is the primary model with fields covering multiple lyric types:

- **`songid`** — mapped from `"songID"` via validation alias
- **`lyric`** — original lyric text
- **`trans`** — translation
- **`roma`** — romanized lyrics
- **`singing_annotations_lyric`** — mapped from `"singingAnnotationsLyric"`, for助唱 (backing vocal) annotations
- **Four timestamp fields** (`lrc_t`, `qrc_t`, `trans_t`, `roma_t`, `singing_annotations_ts`) tracking update times
- **Three boolean flags** (`has_contributor`, `has_trans_contributor`, `has_multi_trans`) indicating availability of contributed lyrics

### Supporting Models

| Model | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GetSingingAnnotationsInfoResponse` | Simple check for whether助唱 lyrics exist |
| `MultiStyleLyricItem` | Represents a single multi-style translation entry (style ID, name, lyric, timestamp) |
| `BatchGetMultiStyleTransLyricResponse` | Wraps a list of `MultiStyleLyricItem` objects |
| `IsAIDictExistsResponse` | Boolean flag for AI dictionary availability |
| `AIDictItem` | One dictionary entry: phrase, explanation, source lyric line, translation, timestamp |
| `GetAIDictResponse` | Wraps a list of `AIDictItem` under `"dictList"` alias |

---

## Decryption Flow

The critical behavior is in the `@model_validator(mode="before")` decorators. Two models have them:

### For `GetLyricResponse`:

The class method `_decrypt_lyrics` runs **before** field parsing. It iterates over four target fields — `"lyric"`, `"trans"`, `"roma"`, and `"singingAnnotationsLyric"` — and applies `qrc_decrypt` to each if the value is a non-empty string. Decryption failures are silently swallowed using `contextlib.suppress(ValueError, TypeError)`.

### For `MultiStyleLyricItem`:

Similarly, `_decrypt_lyric` decrypts only the `"lyric"` field (the translation text for that style), with the same error suppression pattern.

The decryption function `qrc_decrypt` is imported from `"..algorithms"`, suggesting it lives in a sibling module within the package hierarchy.

---

## Data Flow

```
Raw API JSON response
        │
        ▼
model_validator(mode="before") runs
        │
        ├─ Fields with string values in target set → qrc_decrypt() applied
        │     (silently skips on ValueError/TypeError)
        │
        ▼
Pydantic field parsing with aliases
        │
        ├─ validation_alias maps snake_case → camelCase (e.g., "hasContributor")
        │
        ▼
Validated model instance with decrypted content
```

The aliases bridge the API's camelCase JSON keys to Pythonic snake_case attribute names. The decryption happens at the outermost layer (pre-validation), so the decrypted values then flow through normal Pydantic validation and type coercion.

---

## Key Design Observations

1. **Decryption is transparent** — consumers receive decrypted strings without needing to call `qrc_decrypt` themselves.
2. **Graceful degradation** — if decryption fails or returns unexpected types, the original value is preserved thanks to `contextlib.suppress`.
3. **Selective decryption** — not all string fields are decrypted (e.g., `style_name` and `phrase` remain as-is), implying that only certain fields are QRC-encrypted by the API.
4. **Base class reuse** — all models extend `Response`, suggesting common fields like status code or error handling live there (not shown in this snippet).

The actual `qrc_decrypt` implementation is not included here, but based on the function name and the QRC context, it likely reverses the QRC encryption algorithm used by QQ Music for its lyric content.

# Triple-DES 自定义实现分析

这段代码是用于 **QQ 音乐 QRC 歌词解密** 的定制 Triple-DES 实现。我来梳理一下它的结构和特点：

## 概述

这是一个与标准 Triple-DES 不完全兼容的变体实现，参考了 [QQMusicDecoder](https://github.com/WXRIW/QQMusicDecoder) 的 C# 代码移植而来。

## 核心组件

### 1. S-box 表（8 个标准 DES S-box）
代码包含了完整的 S1-S8 替换表（每个 4×16 矩阵），这是标准的 DES S-box 结构。

### 2. `sbox_bit(a)` — 位重排函数
对输入整数进行跨字节的位重新排列，用于在 S-box 查找前重组索引位。

### 3. 初始置换 `initial_permutation` / 逆初始置换 `inverse_permutation`
标准 DES 的 IP 和 IP⁻¹ 置换。

### 4. DES Feistel 函数 `f(state, key)`
- 输入：32 位状态 + 6 字节子密钥
- 执行扩展置换（将 32 位扩展到 48 位）
- 与子密钥异或
- 通过 8 个 S-box 替换
- 最后做 P 置换输出

### 5. 密钥扩展 `key_schedule(key, mode)`
**关键差异**：文档注释中提到包含了一个 "custom PC-2 offset bug"——即 PC-2 置换表与标准 DES 不同，这是为了兼容 QQ 音乐的解密需求。

```python
# 标准 PC-2 索引与这里的 `key_compression` 表不同
# 这里使用了自定义偏移量
```

密钥调度流程：
- 将 8 字节密钥通过 PC-1 置换拆分为 C、D（各 28 位）
- 16 轮循环移位（根据 `key_rnd_shift`）
- 通过自定义 PC-2 压缩置换生成每轮的 6 字节子密钥
- 解密模式时子密钥逆序使用

### 6. Triple-DES 配置 `tripledes_key_setup(key, mode)`
使用 24 字节密钥，分成 3 个 8 字节子密钥，采用 **EDE（Encrypt-Decrypt-Encrypt）** 结构：

| 模式 | Key1 | Key2 | Key3 |
|------|------|------|------|
| 加密 | ENCRYPT | DECRYPT | ENCRYPT |
| 解密 | DECRYPT | ENCRYPT | DECRYPT |

### 7. `tripledes_crypt(input_data, key)` — 主加解密函数
对 8 字节块依次用 3 个 DES 实例处理（EDE 模式）。

## 与标准 Triple-DES 的关键区别

1. **PC-2 置换表偏移量不同**（刻意为之的 "bug"）
2. **每轮迭代处理方式**可能与标准实现有细节差异
3. 专为 QRC 歌词格式设计，不保证与通用 3DES 互操作

# Triple-DES 自定义实现分析

这段代码是用于 **QQ 音乐 QRC 歌词解密** 的定制 Triple-DES 实现。我来梳理一下它的结构和特点：

## 概述

这是一个与标准 Triple-DES 不完全兼容的变体实现，参考了 [QQMusicDecoder](https://github.com/WXRIW/QQMusicDecoder) 的 C# 代码移植而来。

## 核心组件

### 1. S-box 表（8 个标准 DES S-box）
代码包含了完整的 S1-S8 替换表（每个 4×16 矩阵），这是标准的 DES S-box 结构。

### 2. `sbox_bit(a)` — 位重排函数
对输入整数进行跨字节的位重新排列，用于在 S-box 查找前重组索引位。

### 3. 初始置换 `initial_permutation` / 逆初始置换 `inverse_permutation`
标准 DES 的 IP 和 IP⁻¹ 置换。

### 4. DES Feistel 函数 `f(state, key)`
- 输入：32 位状态 + 6 字节子密钥
- 执行扩展置换（将 32 位扩展到 48 位）
- 与子密钥异或
- 通过 8 个 S-box 替换
- 最后做 P 置换输出

### 5. 密钥扩展 `key_schedule(key, mode)`
**关键差异**：文档注释中提到包含了一个 "custom PC-2 offset bug"——即 PC-2 置换表与标准 DES 不同，这是为了兼容 QQ 音乐的解密需求。

```python
# 标准 PC-2 索引与这里的 `key_compression` 表不同
# 这里使用了自定义偏移量
```

密钥调度流程：
- 将 8 字节密钥通过 PC-1 置换拆分为 C、D（各 28 位）
- 16 轮循环移位（根据 `key_rnd_shift`）
- 通过自定义 PC-2 压缩置换生成每轮的 6 字节子密钥
- 解密模式时子密钥逆序使用

### 6. Triple-DES 配置 `tripledes_key_setup(key, mode)`
使用 24 字节密钥，分成 3 个 8 字节子密钥，采用 **EDE（Encrypt-Decrypt-Encrypt）** 结构：

| 模式 | Key1 | Key2 | Key3 |
|------|------|------|------|
| 加密 | ENCRYPT | DECRYPT | ENCRYPT |
| 解密 | DECRYPT | ENCRYPT | DECRYPT |

### 7. `tripledes_crypt(input_data, key)` — 主加解密函数
对 8 字节块依次用 3 个 DES 实例处理（EDE 模式）。

## 与标准 Triple-DES 的关键区别

1. **PC-2 置换表偏移量不同**（刻意为之的 "bug"）
2. **每轮迭代处理方式**可能与标准实现有细节差异
3. 专为 QRC 歌词格式设计，不保证与通用 3DES 互操作

"""算法实现模块."""

import zlib

from .sign import zzc_sign
from .tripledes import DECRYPT, tripledes_crypt, tripledes_key_setup

_QRC_3DES_KEY = b"!@#)(*$%123ZXC!@!@#)(NHL"


def qrc_decrypt(encrypted_qrc: str | bytearray | bytes) -> str:
    """QRC 解码.

    Args:
        encrypted_qrc: 加密的 QRC 数据.

    Returns:
        str: 解密后的 QRC 数据.

    Raises:
        TypeError: 无效的加密数据类型.
        ValueError: 解密失败.
    """
    if not encrypted_qrc:
        return ""

    if isinstance(encrypted_qrc, str):
        encrypted_bytes = bytes.fromhex(encrypted_qrc)
    elif isinstance(encrypted_qrc, bytearray | bytes):
        encrypted_bytes = bytes(encrypted_qrc)
    else:
        raise TypeError("无效的加密数据类型")

    try:
        schedule = tripledes_key_setup(_QRC_3DES_KEY, DECRYPT)
        chunks = [
            tripledes_crypt(bytearray(encrypted_bytes[i : i + 8]), schedule) for i in range(0, len(encrypted_bytes), 8)
        ]
        data = b"".join(chunks)
        return zlib.decompress(data).decode("utf-8")
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"解密失败: {exc}") from exc


__all__ = [
    "qrc_decrypt",
    "zzc_sign",
]

"""Lyric API 返回模型定义."""

import contextlib

from pydantic import Field, model_validator

from ..algorithms import qrc_decrypt
from .request import Response


class GetLyricResponse(Response):
    """歌词接口返回响应.

    Attributes:
        songid: 歌曲 ID.
        lyric: 原始歌词内容.
        trans: 翻译歌词内容.
        roma: 罗马音歌词内容.
        singing_annotations: 助唱标注歌词内容.
        lrc_t: LRC 歌词更新时间戳.
        qrc_t: QRC 歌词更新时间戳.
        trans_t: 翻译歌词更新时间戳.
        roma_t: 罗马音歌词更新时间戳.
        singing_annotations_ts: 助唱标注歌词时间戳.
        has_contributor: 是否有歌词贡献者.
        has_trans_contributor: 是否有翻译贡献者.
        has_multi_trans: 是否有多风格翻译歌词.
    """

    songid: int = Field(validation_alias="songID")
    lyric: str
    trans: str = ""
    roma: str = ""
    singing_annotations_lyric: str = Field(default="", validation_alias="singingAnnotationsLyric")
    lrc_t: int = 0
    qrc_t: int = 0
    trans_t: int = 0
    roma_t: int = 0
    singing_annotations_ts: int = Field(default=0, validation_alias="singingAnnotationsTs")
    has_contributor: bool = Field(default=False, validation_alias="hasContributor")
    has_trans_contributor: bool = Field(default=False, validation_alias="hasTransContributor")
    has_multi_trans: bool = Field(default=False, validation_alias="hasMultiTrans")

    @model_validator(mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _decrypt_lyrics(cls, data: dict) -> dict:
        target_fields = ("lyric", "trans", "roma", "singingAnnotationsLyric")
        for field in target_fields:
            value = data.get(field)
            if value and isinstance(value, str):
                with contextlib.suppress(ValueError, TypeError):
                    data[field] = qrc_decrypt(value)
        return data


class GetSingingAnnotationsInfoResponse(Response):
    """获取助唱标注歌词信息响应模型.

    Attributes:
        has_singing_annotations_lyric: 是否包含助唱标注歌词.
    """

    has_singing_annotations_lyric: bool = Field(default=False, validation_alias="hasSingingAnnotationsLyric")


class MultiStyleLyricItem(Response):
    """多风格翻译歌词项模型.

    Attributes:
        style: 风格 ID.
        style_name: 风格名称.
        lyric: 翻译歌词内容.
        timestamp: 时间戳.
    """

    style: int
    style_name: str = Field(validation_alias="styleName")
    lyric: str
    timestamp: int = 0

    @model_validator(mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _decrypt_lyric(cls, data: dict) -> dict:
        value = data.get("lyric")
        if value and isinstance(value, str):
            with contextlib.suppress(ValueError, TypeError):
                data["lyric"] = qrc_decrypt(value)
        return data


class BatchGetMultiStyleTransLyricResponse(Response):
    """多风格翻译歌词接口响应.

    Attributes:
        lyrics: 多风格翻译歌词列表.
    """

    lyrics: list[MultiStyleLyricItem] = Field(default_factory=list)


class IsAIDictExistsResponse(Response):
    """检查是否存在 AI 歌词词典响应模型.

    Attributes:
        exists: 是否存在 AI 歌词词典.
    """

    exists: bool = False


class AIDictItem(Response):
    """AI 歌词词典项模型.

    Attributes:
        phrase: 划词 / 难词短语.
        explain: AI 详细释义与语境解析.
        lyric_text: 词语所在的歌词原文行.
        trans_lyric_text: 歌词原文行的中文翻译.
        lyric_timestamp: 歌词时间戳.
    """

    phrase: str = ""
    explain: str = ""
    lyric_text: str = ""
    trans_lyric_text: str = ""
    lyric_timestamp: str = ""


class GetAIDictResponse(Response):
    """获取 AI 歌词词典响应模型.

    Attributes:
        dict_list: AI 歌词词典列表.
    """

/**

 *   即: D-K3 → E-K2 → D-K1
 */
fun decrypt3DesEde(encryptedBytes: ByteArray): ByteArray {
    require(encryptedBytes.size % DES_BLOCK_SIZE == 0) {
        "数据长度 ${encryptedBytes.size} 不是 ${DES_BLOCK_SIZE} 的倍数"
    }

    println("   逐块 3DES 解密...")
    val schedule = Tripledes.tripledesKeySetup(Tripledes.KEY_24, Tripledes.DECRYPT)
    val result = ByteArray(encryptedBytes.size)
    val blockCount = encryptedBytes.size / DES_BLOCK_SIZE

    for (blockIdx in 0 until blockCount) {
        val offset = blockIdx * DES_BLOCK_SIZE
        val block = encryptedBytes.copyOfRange(offset, offset + DES_BLOCK_SIZE)
        val decrypted = Tripledes.tripledesCrypt(block, schedule)

        // 对前 3 个块输出调试信息

            println("       输入:  ${block.joinToString(" ") { "%02X".format(it) }}")
            println("       输出:  ${decrypted.joinToString(" ") { "%02X".format(it) }}")
        }

        decrypted.copyInto(result, offset)
    }

    return result
}

    fun inversePermutation(s0: Int, s1: Int): ByteArray {
        val data = ByteArray(8)
        data[3] = (
            ((s1 shr 24) and 1) shl 7 or ((s0 shr 24) and 1) shl 6 or
            ((s1 shr 16) and 1) shl 5 or ((s0 shr 16) and 1) shl 4 or
            ((s1 shr 8) and 1) shl 3 or ((s0 shr 8) and 1) shl 2 or
            (s1 and 1) shl 1 or (s0 and 1)
        ).toByte()
        data[2] = (
            ((s1 shr 25) and 1) shl 7 or ((s0 shr 25) and 1) shl 6 or
            ((s1 shr 17) and 1) shl 5 or ((s0 shr 17) and 1) shl 4 or
            ((s1 shr 9) and 1) shl 3 or ((s0 shr 9) and 1) shl 2 or
            ((s1 shr 1) and 1) shl 1 or ((s0 shr 1) and 1)
        ).toByte()
        data[1] = (
            ((s1 shr 26) and 1) shl 7 or ((s0 shr 26) and 1) shl 6 or
            ((s1 shr 18) and 1) shl 5 or ((s0 shr 18) and 1) shl 4 or
            ((s1 shr 10) and 1) shl 3 or ((s0 shr 10) and 1) shl 2 or
            ((s1 shr 2) and 1) shl 1 or ((s0 shr 2) and 1)
        ).toByte()
        data[0] = (
            ((s1 shr 27) and 1) shl 7 or ((s0 shr 27) and 1) shl 6 or
            ((s1 shr 19) and 1) shl 5 or ((s0 shr 19) and 1) shl 4 or
            ((s1 shr 11) and 1) shl 3 or ((s0 shr 11) and 1) shl 2 or
            ((s1 shr 3) and 1) shl 1 or ((s0 shr 3) and 1)
        ).toByte()
        data[7] = (
            ((s1 shr 28) and 1) shl 7 or ((s0 shr 28) and 1) shl 6 or
            ((s1 shr 20) and 1) shl 5 or ((s0 shr 20) and 1) shl 4 or
            ((s1 shr 12) and 1) shl 3 or ((s0 shr 12) and 1) shl 2 or
            ((s1 shr 4) and 1) shl 1 or ((s0 shr 4) and 1)
        ).toByte()
        data[6] = (
            ((s1 shr 29) and 1) shl 7 or ((s0 shr 29) and 1) shl 6 or
            ((s1 shr 21) and 1) shl 5 or ((s0 shr 21) and 1) shl 4 or
            ((s1 shr 13) and 1) shl 3 or ((s0 shr 13) and 1) shl 2 or
            ((s1 shr 5) and 1) shl 1 or ((s0 shr 5) and 1)
        ).toByte()
        data[5] = (
            ((s1 shr 30) and 1) shl 7 or ((s0 shr 30) and 1) shl 6 or
            ((s1 shr 22) and 1) shl 5 or ((s0 shr 22) and 1) shl 4 or
            ((s1 shr 14) and 1) shl 3 or ((s0 shr 14) and 1) shl 2 or
            ((s1 shr 6) and 1) shl 1 or ((s0 shr 6) and 1)

    private fun f(state: Int, key: List<Int>): Int {
        // E盒扩展: t1/t2
        val t1 = (
            ((state and 1) shl 31) or
            ((state and 0xF8000000.toInt()) shr 1) or
            ((state and 0x1F800000) shr 3) or
            ((state and 0x01F80000) shr 5) or
            ((state and 0x001F8000) shr 7)
        )
        val t2 = (
            ((state and 0x0001F800) shl 15) or
            ((state and 0x00001F80) shl 13) or
            ((state and 0x000001F8) shl 11) or
            ((state and 0x0000001F) shl 9) or
            ((state and 0x80000000.toInt()) shr 23)
        )

        val k0 = ((t1 shr 24) and 0xFF) xor key[0]
        val k1 = ((t1 shr 16) and 0xFF) xor key[1]
        val k2 = ((t1 shr 8) and 0xFF) xor key[2]
        val k3 = ((t2 shr 24) and 0xFF) xor key[3]
        val k4 = ((t2 shr 16) and 0xFF) xor key[4]
        val k5 = ((t2 shr 8) and 0xFF) xor key[5]

        val sboxOut = (
            (sbox[0][sboxBit(k0 shr 2)] shl 28) or
            (sbox[1][sboxBit(((k0 and 0x03) shl 4) or (k1 shr 4))] shl 24) or
            (sbox[2][sboxBit(((k1 and 0x0F) shl 2) or (k2 shr 6))] shl 20) or
            (sbox[3][sboxBit(k2 and 0x3F)] shl 16) or
            (sbox[4][sboxBit(k3 shr 2)] shl 12) or
            (sbox[5][sboxBit(((k3 and 0x03) shl 4) or (k4 shr 4))] shl 8) or
            (sbox[6][sboxBit(((k4 and 0x0F) shl 2) or (k5 shr 6))] shl 4) or
            sbox[7][sboxBit(k5 and 0x3F)]
        )

        // P盒置换 (inline)
        return (
            ((sboxOut shr 16) and 1) shl 31 or
            ((sboxOut shr 25) and 1) shl 30 or
            ((sboxOut shr 12) and 1) shl 29 or
            ((sboxOut shr 11) and 1) shl 28 or
            ((sboxOut shr 3) and 1) shl 27 or
            ((sboxOut shr 20) and 1) shl 26 or
            ((sboxOut shr 4) and 1) shl 25 or
            ((sboxOut shr 15) and 1) shl 24 or
            ((sboxOut shr 31) and 1) shl 23 or
            ((sboxOut shr 17) and 1) shl 22 or
            ((sboxOut shr 9) and 1) shl 21 or
            ((sboxOut shr 6) and 1) shl 20 or
            ((sboxOut shr 27) and 1) shl 19 or
            ((sboxOut shr 14) and 1) shl 18 or
            ((sboxOut shr 1) and 1) shl 17 or
            ((sboxOut shr 22) and 1) shl 16 or
            ((sboxOut shr 30) and 1) shl 15 or
            ((sboxOut shr 24) and 1) shl 14 or
            ((sboxOut shr 8) and 1) shl 13 or
            ((sboxOut shr 18) and 1) shl 12 or
            (sboxOut and 1) shl 11 or
            ((sboxOut shr 5) and 1) shl 10 or
            ((sboxOut shr 29) and 1) shl 9 or
            ((sboxOut shr 23) and 1) shl 8 or
            ((sboxOut shr 13) and 1) shl 7 or
            ((sboxOut shr 19) and 1) shl 6 or
            ((sboxOut shr 2) and 1) shl 5 or
            ((sboxOut shr 26) and 1) shl 4 or
            ((sboxOut shr 10) and 1) shl 3 or
            ((sboxOut shr 21) and 1) shl 2 or
            ((sboxOut shr 28) and 1) shl 1 or
            ((sboxOut shr 7) and 1)
        )
    }

    private fun cryptBlock(input: ByteArray, key: Array<ByteArray>): ByteArray {
        var (s0, s1) = initialPermutation(input)

        for (idx in 0 until 15) {
            val prevS1 = s1
            val keyList = key[idx].map { it.toInt() and 0xFF }
            s1 = f(s1, keyList) xor s0
            s0 = prevS1
        }
        val lastKey = key[15].map { it.toInt() and 0xFF }
        s0 = f(s1, lastKey) xor s0

        return inversePermutation(s0, s1)
    }

    fun keySchedule(key: ByteArray, mode: Int): Array<ByteArray> {
        val schedule = Array(16) { ByteArray(6) }
        val keyRndShift = intArrayOf(1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1)

        val keyPermC = intArrayOf(
            56,48,40,32,24,16,8,0,57,49,41,33,25,17,9,1,
            58,50,42,34,26,18,10,2,59,51,43,35
        )
        val keyPermD = intArrayOf(
            62,54,46,38,30,22,14,6,61,53,45,37,29,21,13,5,
            60,52,44,36,28,20,12,4,27,19,11,3
        )
        val keyCompression = intArrayOf(
            13,16,10,23,0,4,2,27,14,5,20,9,22,18,11,3,
            25,7,15,6,26,19,12,1,40,51,30,36,46,54,29,39,
            50,44,32,47,43,48,38,55,33,52,45,41,49,35,28,31
        )

        val v0 = (key[0].toInt() and 0xFF) or ((key[1].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
                ((key[2].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 16) or ((key[3].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 24)
        val v1 = (key[4].toInt() and 0xFF) or ((key[5].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
                ((key[6].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 16) or ((key[7].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 24)

        var c = 0L
        for (i in keyPermC.indices) {
            val b = keyPermC[i]
            val bit = if (b < 32) ((v0 ushr (31 - b)) and 1).toLong()
                      else ((v1 ushr (63 - b)) and 1).toLong()
            c = c or (bit shl (31 - i))
        }

        var d = 0L
        for (i in keyPermD.indices) {
            val b = keyPermD[i]
            val bit = if (b < 32) ((v0 ushr (31 - b)) and 1).toLong()
                      else ((v1 ushr (63 - b)) and 1).toLong()
            d = d or (bit shl (31 - i))
        }

        for (i in 0 until 16) {
            c = ((c shl keyRndShift[i]) or (c ushr (28 - keyRndShift[i]))) and 0xFFFFFFF0L
            d = ((d shl keyRndShift[i]) or (d ushr (28 - keyRndShift[i]))) and 0xFFFFFFF0L

            val togen = if (mode == DECRYPT) 15 - i else i

            for (j in 0 until 24) {
                val bit = ((c ushr (31 - keyCompression[j])) and 1L).toInt()
                schedule[togen][j / 8] = (schedule[togen][j / 8].toInt() or (bit shl (7 - (j % 8)))).toByte()
            }
            for (j in 24 until 48) {
                val bit = ((d ushr (31 - (keyCompression[j] - 27))) and 1L).toInt()
                schedule[togen][j / 8] = (schedule[togen][j / 8].toInt() or (bit shl (7 - (j % 8)))).toByte()
            }
        }

        return schedule
    }

    fun tripledesKeySetup(key: ByteArray, mode: Int): List<Array<ByteArray>> {
        return if (mode == ENCRYPT) {
            listOf(
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(0, 8), ENCRYPT),
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(8, 16), DECRYPT),
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(16, 24), ENCRYPT)
            )
        } else {
            listOf(
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(16, 24), DECRYPT),  // K3: "!@#)(NHL"
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(8, 16), ENCRYPT),   // K2: "123ZXC!@"
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(0, 8), DECRYPT)     // K1: "!@#)(*$%"
            )
        }
    }

    fun tripledesCrypt(data: ByteArray, key: List<Array<ByteArray>>): ByteArray {
        var result = data.copyOf()
        for (i in 0 until 3) {
            result = cryptBlock(result, key[i])
        }
        return result
    }
}

"""Lyric API 返回模型定义."""

import contextlib

from pydantic import Field, model_validator

from ..algorithms import qrc_decrypt
from .request import Response


class GetLyricResponse(Response):
    """歌词接口返回响应.

    Attributes:
        songid: 歌曲 ID.
        lyric: 原始歌词内容.
        trans: 翻译歌词内容.
        roma: 罗马音歌词内容.
        singing_annotations: 助唱标注歌词内容.
        lrc_t: LRC 歌词更新时间戳.
        qrc_t: QRC 歌词更新时间戳.
        trans_t: 翻译歌词更新时间戳.
        roma_t: 罗马音歌词更新时间戳.
        singing_annotations_ts: 助唱标注歌词时间戳.
        has_contributor: 是否有歌词贡献者.
        has_trans_contributor: 是否有翻译贡献者.
        has_multi_trans: 是否有多风格翻译歌词.
    """

    songid: int = Field(validation_alias="songID")
    lyric: str
    trans: str = ""
    roma: str = ""
    singing_annotations_lyric: str = Field(default="", validation_alias="singingAnnotationsLyric")
    lrc_t: int = 0
    qrc_t: int = 0
    trans_t: int = 0
    roma_t: int = 0
    singing_annotations_ts: int = Field(default=0, validation_alias="singingAnnotationsTs")
    has_contributor: bool = Field(default=False, validation_alias="hasContributor")
    has_trans_contributor: bool = Field(default=False, validation_alias="hasTransContributor")
    has_multi_trans: bool = Field(default=False, validation_alias="hasMultiTrans")

    @model_validator(mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _decrypt_lyrics(cls, data: dict) -> dict:
        target_fields = ("lyric", "trans", "roma", "singingAnnotationsLyric")
        for field in target_fields:
            value = data.get(field)
            if value and isinstance(value, str):
                with contextlib.suppress(ValueError, TypeError):
                    data[field] = qrc_decrypt(value)
        return data


class GetSingingAnnotationsInfoResponse(Response):
    """获取助唱标注歌词信息响应模型.

    Attributes:
        has_singing_annotations_lyric: 是否包含助唱标注歌词.
    """

    has_singing_annotations_lyric: bool = Field(default=False, validation_alias="hasSingingAnnotationsLyric")


class MultiStyleLyricItem(Response):
    """多风格翻译歌词项模型.

    Attributes:
        style: 风格 ID.
        style_name: 风格名称.
        lyric: 翻译歌词内容.
        timestamp: 时间戳.
    """

    style: int
    style_name: str = Field(validation_alias="styleName")
    lyric: str
    timestamp: int = 0

    @model_validator(mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _decrypt_lyric(cls, data: dict) -> dict:
        value = data.get("lyric")
        if value and isinstance(value, str):
            with contextlib.suppress(ValueError, TypeError):
                data["lyric"] = qrc_decrypt(value)
        return data


class BatchGetMultiStyleTransLyricResponse(Response):
    """多风格翻译歌词接口响应.

    Attributes:
        lyrics: 多风格翻译歌词列表.
    """

    lyrics: list[MultiStyleLyricItem] = Field(default_factory=list)


class IsAIDictExistsResponse(Response):
    """检查是否存在 AI 歌词词典响应模型.

    Attributes:
        exists: 是否存在 AI 歌词词典.
    """

    exists: bool = False


class AIDictItem(Response):
    """AI 歌词词典项模型.

    Attributes:
        phrase: 划词 / 难词短语.
        explain: AI 详细释义与语境解析.
        lyric_text: 词语所在的歌词原文行.
        trans_lyric_text: 歌词原文行的中文翻译.
        lyric_timestamp: 歌词时间戳.
    """

    phrase: str = ""
    explain: str = ""
    lyric_text: str = ""
    trans_lyric_text: str = ""
    lyric_timestamp: str = ""


class GetAIDictResponse(Response):
    """获取 AI 歌词词典响应模型.

    Attributes:
        dict_list: AI 歌词词典列表.
    """

    dict_list: list[AIDictItem] = Field(default_factory=list, validation_alias="dictList")

"""算法实现模块."""

import zlib

from .sign import zzc_sign
from .tripledes import DECRYPT, tripledes_crypt, tripledes_key_setup

_QRC_3DES_KEY = b"!@#)(*$%123ZXC!@!@#)(NHL"


def qrc_decrypt(encrypted_qrc: str | bytearray | bytes) -> str:
    """QRC 解码.

    Args:
        encrypted_qrc: 加密的 QRC 数据.

    Returns:
        str: 解密后的 QRC 数据.

    Raises:
        TypeError: 无效的加密数据类型.
        ValueError: 解密失败.
    """
    if not encrypted_qrc:
        return ""

    if isinstance(encrypted_qrc, str):
        encrypted_bytes = bytes.fromhex(encrypted_qrc)
    elif isinstance(encrypted_qrc, bytearray | bytes):
        encrypted_bytes = bytes(encrypted_qrc)
    else:
        raise TypeError("无效的加密数据类型")

    try:
        schedule = tripledes_key_setup(_QRC_3DES_KEY, DECRYPT)
        chunks = [
            tripledes_crypt(bytearray(encrypted_bytes[i : i + 8]), schedule) for i in range(0, len(encrypted_bytes), 8)
        ]
        data = b"".join(chunks)
        return zlib.decompress(data).decode("utf-8")
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"解密失败: {exc}") from exc


__all__ = [
    "qrc_decrypt",
    "zzc_sign",
]

689	/**
690	 * 3DES-EDE 解密
691	 *
692	 * Python tripledes_key_setup 24字节密钥 DECRYPT 模式:
693	 *   [key[16:24]="!@#)(NHL" DECRYPT, key[8:16]="123ZXC!@" ENCRYPT, key[0:8]="!@#)(*$%" DECRYPT]
694	 *   即: D-K3 → E-K2 → D-K1
695	 */
696	fun decrypt3DesEde(encryptedBytes: ByteArray): ByteArray {
697	    require(encryptedBytes.size % DES_BLOCK_SIZE == 0) {
698	        "数据长度 ${encryptedBytes.size} 不是 ${DES_BLOCK_SIZE} 的倍数"
699	    }
700	
701	    println("   逐块 3DES 解密...")
702	    val schedule = Tripledes.tripledesKeySetup(Tripledes.KEY_24, Tripledes.DECRYPT)
703	    val result = ByteArray(encryptedBytes.size)
704	    val blockCount = encryptedBytes.size / DES_BLOCK_SIZE
705	
706	    for (blockIdx in 0 until blockCount) {
707	        val offset = blockIdx * DES_BLOCK_SIZE
708	        val block = encryptedBytes.copyOfRange(offset, offset + DES_BLOCK_SIZE)
709	        val decrypted = Tripledes.tripledesCrypt(block, schedule)
710	
711	        // 对前 3 个块输出调试信息
712	        if (blockIdx < 3) {
713	            println("     块 ${blockIdx + 1}/$blockCount (偏移 $offset):")
714	            println("       输入:  ${block.joinToString(" ") { "%02X".format(it) }}")
715	            println("       输出:  ${decrypted.joinToString(" ") { "%02X".format(it) }}")
716	        }
717	
718	        decrypted.copyInto(result, offset)
719	    }
720	
721	    return result
722	}

   - QQ Music QRC encryption flow: Hex → 3DES-EDE → Zlib → UTF-8/GBK text

     - Custom Initial Permutation (Python's inline bit-level computation, not standard IP table)
     - Custom E-box expansion (Python's t1/t2 bit manipulation, not standard E-box table)
     - Custom S-box index calculation: `sboxBit(a) = (a & 32) | ((a & 31) >> 1) | ((a & 1) << 4)`
     - 24-byte key: `"!@#)(*$%123ZXC!@!@#)(NHL"` split as K1(0-7)="!@#)(*$%", K2(8-15)="123ZXC!@", K3(16-23)="!@#)(NHL"
     - DECRYPT mode key order (Python's `tripledes_key_setup`): `[key[16:24] DECRYPT, key[8:16] ENCRYPT, key[0:8] DECRYPT]` = K3→K2→K1
     - 16-round DES loop with 15 normal rounds + 1 final round (not 16 normal rounds)
   - QQ Music API endpoints:
     - Search: POST `https://u.y.qq.com/cgi-bin/musicu.fcg` with `DoSearchForQQMusicDesktop` module

   - The `qrc` field in the response is a boolean flag (1=available, 0=unavailable), NOT the actual QRC content

"""Lyric API 返回模型定义."""

import contextlib

from pydantic import Field, model_validator

from ..algorithms import qrc_decrypt
from .request import Response


class GetLyricResponse(Response):
    """歌词接口返回响应.

    Attributes:
        songid: 歌曲 ID.
        lyric: 原始歌词内容.
        trans: 翻译歌词内容.
        roma: 罗马音歌词内容.
        singing_annotations: 助唱标注歌词内容.
        lrc_t: LRC 歌词更新时间戳.
        qrc_t: QRC 歌词更新时间戳.
        trans_t: 翻译歌词更新时间戳.
        roma_t: 罗马音歌词更新时间戳.
        singing_annotations_ts: 助唱标注歌词时间戳.
        has_contributor: 是否有歌词贡献者.
        has_trans_contributor: 是否有翻译贡献者.
        has_multi_trans: 是否有多风格翻译歌词.
    """

    songid: int = Field(validation_alias="songID")
    lyric: str
    trans: str = ""
    roma: str = ""
    singing_annotations_lyric: str = Field(default="", validation_alias="singingAnnotationsLyric")
    lrc_t: int = 0
    qrc_t: int = 0
    trans_t: int = 0
    roma_t: int = 0
    singing_annotations_ts: int = Field(default=0, validation_alias="singingAnnotationsTs")
    has_contributor: bool = Field(default=False, validation_alias="hasContributor")
    has_trans_contributor: bool = Field(default=False, validation_alias="hasTransContributor")
    has_multi_trans: bool = Field(default=False, validation_alias="hasMultiTrans")

    @model_validator(mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _decrypt_lyrics(cls, data: dict) -> dict:
        target_fields = ("lyric", "trans", "roma", "singingAnnotationsLyric")
        for field in target_fields:
            value = data.get(field)
            if value and isinstance(value, str):
                with contextlib.suppress(ValueError, TypeError):
                    data[field] = qrc_decrypt(value)
        return data


class GetSingingAnnotationsInfoResponse(Response):
    """获取助唱标注歌词信息响应模型.

    Attributes:
        has_singing_annotations_lyric: 是否包含助唱标注歌词.

        d = ((d shl keyRndShift[i]) or (d ushr (28 - keyRndShift[i]))) and 0xFFFFFFF0L

fun tripledesKeySetup(key: ByteArray, mode: Int): Array<Array<ByteArray>> {
    return if (mode == ENCRYPT) {
        arrayOf(keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(0, 8), ENCRYPT),
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(8, 16), DECRYPT),
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(16, 24), ENCRYPT))
    } else {
        arrayOf(keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(16, 24), DECRYPT),
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(8, 16), ENCRYPT),
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(0, 8), DECRYPT))
    }
}

fun f(state: Int, key: ByteArray): Int {

    val k1 = ((t1 ushr 16) and 0xFF) xor (key[1].toInt() and 0xFF)
    val k2 = ((t1 ushr 8) and 0xFF) xor (key[2].toInt() and 0xFF)
    val k3 = ((t2 ushr 24) and 0xFF) xor (key[3].toInt() and 0xFF)
    val k4 = ((t2 ushr 16) and 0xFF) xor (key[4].toInt() and 0xFF)
    val k5 = ((t2 ushr 8) and 0xFF) xor (key[5].toInt() and 0xFF)

    val sboxOut = (
        (sbox[0][sboxBit(k0 ushr 2)] shl 28) or
        (sbox[1][sboxBit(((k0 and 0x03) shl 4) or (k1 ushr 4))] shl 24) or

        (sbox[6][sboxBit(((k4 and 0x0F) shl 2) or (k5 ushr 6))] shl 4) or
        sbox[7][sboxBit(k5 and 0x3F)]
    )

        ((sboxOut ushr 16) and 1) shl 31 or

        ((sboxOut ushr 6) and 1) shl 20 or
        ((sboxOut ushr 27) and 1) shl 19 or
        ((sboxOut ushr 14) and 1) shl 18 or
        ((sboxOut ushr 1) and 1) shl 17 or
        ((sboxOut ushr 22) and 1) shl 16 or
        ((sboxOut ushr 30) and 1) shl 15 or
        ((sboxOut ushr 24) and 1) shl 14 or
        ((sboxOut ushr 8) and 1) shl 13 or

fun cryptBlock(input: ByteArray, key: Array<ByteArray>): ByteArray {
    val (s0init, s1init) = initialPermutation(input)
    println("  IP: s0=0x%08X s1=0x%08X".format(s0init, s1init))

    var s0 = s0init
    var s1 = s1init

    for (idx in 0 until 15) {
        val previousS1 = s1
        s1 = f(s1, key[idx]) xor s0
        s0 = previousS1
        if (idx < 3 || idx >= 13) {
            println("  Round $idx: s0=0x%08X s1=0x%08X".format(s0, s1))
        }
    }
    s0 = f(s1, key[15]) xor s0
    println("  After R15: s0=0x%08X s1=0x%08X".format(s0, s1))

    val result = inversePermutation(s0, s1)
    println("  FP: ${result.joinToString("") { "%02X".format(it) }}")
    return result
}

fun keySchedule(key: ByteArray, mode: Int): Array<ByteArray> {
    val schedule = Array(16) { ByteArray(6) }
    val keyRndShift = intArrayOf(1,1,2,2,2,2,2,2,1,2,2,2,2,2,2,1)
    val keyPermC = intArrayOf(56,48,40,32,24,16,8,0,57,49,41,33,25,17,9,1,58,50,42,34,26,18,10,2,59,51,43,35)
    val keyPermD = intArrayOf(62,54,46,38,30,22,14,6,61,53,45,37,29,21,13,5,60,52,44,36,28,20,12,4,27,19,11,3)
    val keyCompression = intArrayOf(
        13,16,10,23,0,4,2,27,14,5,20,9,22,18,11,3,25,7,15,6,26,19,12,1,
        40,51,30,36,46,54,29,39,50,44,32,47,43,48,38,55,33,52,45,41,49,35,28,31
    )

    val v0 = (key[0].toInt() and 0xFF) or ((key[1].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
            ((key[2].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 16) or ((key[3].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 24)
    val v1 = (key[4].toInt() and 0xFF) or ((key[5].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
            ((key[6].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 16) or ((key[7].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 24)

    // Use Long to avoid signed Int issues in bit manipulation
    var c = 0L
    for (i in keyPermC.indices) {
        val b = keyPermC[i]
        val bit = if (b < 32) ((v0.toLong() ushr (31 - b)) and 1L) else ((v1.toLong() ushr (63 - b)) and 1L)
        c = c or (bit shl (31 - i))
    }
    var d = 0L
    for (i in keyPermD.indices) {
        val b = keyPermD[i]
        val bit = if (b < 32) ((v0.toLong() ushr (31 - b)) and 1L) else ((v1.toLong() ushr (63 - b)) and 1L)
        d = d or (bit shl (31 - i))
    }

    for (i in 0 until 16) {
        c = ((c shl keyRndShift[i]) or (c ushr (28 - keyRndShift[i]))) and 0xFFFFFFF0L
        d = ((d shl keyRndShift[i]) or (d ushr (28 - keyRndShift[i]))) and 0xFFFFFFF0L

        val togen = if (mode == DECRYPT) 15 - i else i

        for (j in 0 until 6) schedule[togen][j] = 0

        for (j in 0 until 24) {
            val bit = (c ushr (31 - keyCompression[j])) and 1L
            schedule[togen][j / 8] = (schedule[togen][j / 8].toInt() or (bit.toInt() shl (7 - (j % 8)))).toByte()
        }
        for (j in 24 until 48) {
            val bit = (d ushr (31 - (keyCompression[j] - 27))) and 1L
            schedule[togen][j / 8] = (schedule[togen][j / 8].toInt() or (bit.toInt() shl (7 - (j % 8)))).toByte()
        }
    }
    return schedule
}

fun tripledesKeySetup(key: ByteArray, mode: Int): Array<Array<ByteArray>> {
    return if (mode == ENCRYPT) {
        arrayOf(keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(0, 8), ENCRYPT),
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(8, 16), DECRYPT),
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(16, 24), ENCRYPT))
    } else {
        arrayOf(keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(16, 24), DECRYPT),
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(8, 16), ENCRYPT),
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(0, 8), DECRYPT))
    }
}

fun tripledesCrypt(data: ByteArray, key: Array<Array<ByteArray>>): ByteArray {
    var result = data.copyOf()
    for (i in 0 until 3) {
        result = cryptBlock(result, key[i])
    }
    return result
}

fun main() {
    println("=== 独立的 3DES IP 测试 ===")

    val KEY_24 = byteArrayOf(
        '!'.code.toByte(), '@'.code.toByte(), '#'.code.toByte(), ')'.code.toByte(),
        '('.code.toByte(), '*'.code.toByte(), '$'.code.toByte(), '%'.code.toByte(),
        '1'.code.toByte(), '2'.code.toByte(), '3'.code.toByte(), 'Z'.code.toByte(),
        'X'.code.toByte(), 'C'.code.toByte(), '!'.code.toByte(), '@'.code.toByte(),
        '!'.code.toByte(), '@'.code.toByte(), '#'.code.toByte(), ')'.code.toByte(),
        '('.code.toByte(), 'N'.code.toByte(), 'H'.code.toByte(), 'L'.code.toByte()
    )
    println("KEY: ${KEY_24.joinToString(" ") { "%02X".format(it) }}")

    val hexData = ""
    val encrypted = hexData.chunked(2).map { it.toInt(16).toByte() }.toByteArray()
    println("Input: ${encrypted.size} bytes, first block: ${encrypted.take(8).joinToString(" ") { "%02X".format(it) }}")

    val schedule = tripledesKeySetup(KEY_24, DECRYPT)
    println("\nKey schedules (first 3 rounds):")
    for (partIdx in 0 until 3) {
        println("  Part $partIdx (${if (partIdx == 0) "K3-D" else if (partIdx == 1) "K2-E" else "K1-D"}):")
        for (r in 0 until 3) {
            val ks = schedule[partIdx][r]
            println("    Round $r: ${ks.joinToString(", ") { "0x%02X".format(it) }}")
        }
    }

    // Test first block with part 0 (K3-D)
    println("\n--- Debug: K3-D first block ---")
    val first = encrypted.copyOfRange(0, 8)
    val dec = tripledesCrypt(first, schedule)
    println("Block 0 result: ${dec.joinToString(" ") { "%02X".format(it) }}")

    // Full
    println("\n--- Full Decrypt ---")
    val allBlocks = (encrypted.indices step 8).map { i ->
        val end = minOf(i + 8, encrypted.size)
        if (end - i < 8) encrypted.copyOfRange(i, end).copyOf(8)
        else encrypted.copyOfRange(i, end)
    }
    val decrypted = allBlocks.flatMap { tripledesCrypt(it, schedule).toList() }.toByteArray()
    println("Decrypted: ${decrypted.size} bytes")
    println("First 32 bytes:\n  ${decrypted.take(32).joinToString(" ") { "%02X".format(it) }}")
    println("First byte: 0x%02X".format(decrypted[0].toInt() and 0xFF))

    if (decrypted[0].toInt() and 0xFF == 0x78) {
        println("✅ First byte is 0x78 (zlib header)!")
        try {
            val bos = ByteArrayOutputStream()
            InflaterOutputStream(bos).use { it.write(decrypted) }
            val result = bos.toByteArray()
            println("Zlib decompressed: ${result.size} bytes")
            println("First 200 chars: ${result.take(200).decodeToString()}")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            println("Zlib failed: ${e.message}")
        }
    }
}

fun cryptBlock(input: ByteArray, key: Array<ByteArray>): ByteArray {
    val (s0init, s1init) = initialPermutation(input)
    println("  IP: s0=0x%08X s1=0x%08X".format(s0init, s1init))

    var s0 = s0init
    var s1 = s1init

    for (idx in 0 until 15) {
        val previousS1 = s1
        s1 = f(s1, key[idx]) xor s0
        s0 = previousS1
        if (idx < 3 || idx >= 13) {
            println("  Round $idx: s0=0x%08X s1=0x%08X".format(s0, s1))
        }
    }
    s0 = f(s1, key[15]) xor s0
    println("  After R15: s0=0x%08X s1=0x%08X".format(s0, s1))

    val result = inversePermutation(s0, s1)
    println("  FP: ${result.joinToString("") { "%02X".format(it) }}")
    return result
}

fun keySchedule(key: ByteArray, mode: Int): Array<ByteArray> {
    val schedule = Array(16) { ByteArray(6) }
    val keyRndShift = intArrayOf(1,1,2,2,2,2,2,2,1,2,2,2,2,2,2,1)
    val keyPermC = intArrayOf(56,48,40,32,24,16,8,0,57,49,41,33,25,17,9,1,58,50,42,34,26,18,10,2,59,51,43,35)
    val keyPermD = intArrayOf(62,54,46,38,30,22,14,6,61,53,45,37,29,21,13,5,60,52,44,36,28,20,12,4,27,19,11,3)
    val keyCompression = intArrayOf(
        13,16,10,23,0,4,2,27,14,5,20,9,22,18,11,3,25,7,15,6,26,19,12,1,
        40,51,30,36,46,54,29,39,50,44,32,47,43,48,38,55,33,52,45,41,49,35,28,31
    )

    val v0 = (key[0].toInt() and 0xFF) or ((key[1].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
            ((key[2].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 16) or ((key[3].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 24)
    val v1 = (key[4].toInt() and 0xFF) or ((key[5].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
            ((key[6].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 16) or ((key[7].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 24)

    // Use Long to avoid signed Int issues in bit manipulation
    var c = 0L
    for (i in keyPermC.indices) {
        val b = keyPermC[i]
        val bit = if (b < 32) ((v0.toLong() ushr (31 - b)) and 1L) else ((v1.toLong() ushr (63 - b)) and 1L)
        c = c or (bit shl (31 - i))
    }
    var d = 0L
    for (i in keyPermD.indices) {
        val b = keyPermD[i]
        val bit = if (b < 32) ((v0.toLong() ushr (31 - b)) and 1L) else ((v1.toLong() ushr (63 - b)) and 1L)
        d = d or (bit shl (31 - i))
    }

    for (i in 0 until 16) {
        c = ((c shl keyRndShift[i]) or (c ushr (28 - keyRndShift[i]))) and 0xFFFFFFF0L
        d = ((d shl keyRndShift[i]) or (d ushr (28 - keyRndShift[i]))) and 0xFFFFFFF0L

        val togen = if (mode == DECRYPT) 15 - i else i

        for (j in 0 until 6) schedule[togen][j] = 0

        for (j in 0 until 24) {
            val bit = (c ushr (31 - keyCompression[j])) and 1L
            schedule[togen][j / 8] = (schedule[togen][j / 8].toInt() or (bit.toInt() shl (7 - (j % 8)))).toByte()
        }
        for (j in 24 until 48) {
            val bit = (d ushr (31 - (keyCompression[j] - 27))) and 1L
            schedule[togen][j / 8] = (schedule[togen][j / 8].toInt() or (bit.toInt() shl (7 - (j % 8)))).toByte()
        }
    }
    return schedule
}

fun tripledesKeySetup(key: ByteArray, mode: Int): Array<Array<ByteArray>> {
    return if (mode == ENCRYPT) {
        arrayOf(keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(0, 8), ENCRYPT),
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(8, 16), DECRYPT),
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(16, 24), ENCRYPT))
    } else {
        arrayOf(keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(16, 24), DECRYPT),
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(8, 16), ENCRYPT),
                keySchedule(key.copyOfRange(0, 8), DECRYPT))
    }
}

fun tripledesCrypt(data: ByteArray, key: Array<Array<ByteArray>>): ByteArray {
    var result = data.copyOf()
    for (i in 0 until 3) {
        result = cryptBlock(result, key[i])
    }
    return result
}

fun main() {
    println("=== 独立的 3DES IP 测试 ===")

    val KEY_24 = byteArrayOf(
        '!'.code.toByte(), '@'.code.toByte(), '#'.code.toByte(), ')'.code.toByte(),
        '('.code.toByte(), '*'.code.toByte(), '$'.code.toByte(), '%'.code.toByte(),
        '1'.code.toByte(), '2'.code.toByte(), '3'.code.toByte(), 'Z'.code.toByte(),
        'X'.code.toByte(), 'C'.code.toByte(), '!'.code.toByte(), '@'.code.toByte(),
        '!'.code.toByte(), '@'.code.toByte(), '#'.code.toByte(), ')'.code.toByte(),
        '('.code.toByte(), 'N'.code.toByte(), 'H'.code.toByte(), 'L'.code.toByte()
    )
    println("KEY: ${KEY_24.joinToString(" ") { "%02X".format(it) }}")

    val hexData = ""
    val encrypted = hexData.chunked(2).map { it.toInt(16).toByte() }.toByteArray()
    println("Input: ${encrypted.size} bytes, first block: ${encrypted.take(8).joinToString(" ") { "%02X".format(it) }}")

    val schedule = tripledesKeySetup(KEY_24, DECRYPT)
    println("\nKey schedules (first 3 rounds):")
    for (partIdx in 0 until 3) {
        println("  Part $partIdx (${if (partIdx == 0) "K3-D" else if (partIdx == 1) "K2-E" else "K1-D"}):")
        for (r in 0 until 3) {
            val ks = schedule[partIdx][r]
            println("    Round $r: ${ks.joinToString(", ") { "0x%02X".format(it) }}")
        }
    }

    // Test first block with part 0 (K3-D)
    println("\n--- Debug: K3-D first block ---")
    val first = encrypted.copyOfRange(0, 8)
    val dec = tripledesCrypt(first, schedule)
    println("Block 0 result: ${dec.joinToString(" ") { "%02X".format(it) }}")

    // Full
    println("\n--- Full Decrypt ---")
    val allBlocks = (encrypted.indices step 8).map { i ->
        val end = minOf(i + 8, encrypted.size)
        if (end - i < 8) encrypted.copyOfRange(i, end).copyOf(8)
        else encrypted.copyOfRange(i, end)
    }
    val decrypted = allBlocks.flatMap { tripledesCrypt(it, schedule).toList() }.toByteArray()
    println("Decrypted: ${decrypted.size} bytes")
    println("First 32 bytes:\n  ${decrypted.take(32).joinToString(" ") { "%02X".format(it) }}")
    println("First byte: 0x%02X".format(decrypted[0].toInt() and 0xFF))

    if (decrypted[0].toInt() and 0xFF == 0x78) {
        println("✅ First byte is 0x78 (zlib header)!")
        try {
            val bos = ByteArrayOutputStream()
            InflaterOutputStream(bos).use { it.write(decrypted) }
            val result = bos.toByteArray()
            println("Zlib decompressed: ${result.size} bytes")
            println("First 200 chars: ${result.take(200).decodeToString()}")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            println("Zlib failed: ${e.message}")
        }
    }
}
