805	private const val ROUNDS = 16
806	private const val SUB_KEY_SIZE = 6
807	private const val DES_BLOCK_SIZE = 8
808	
809	/**
810	 * 3DES-EDE 解密
811	 *
812	 * Python tripledes_key_setup 24字节密钥 DECRYPT 模式:
813	 *   [key[16:24]="!@#)(NHL" DECRYPT, key[8:16]="123ZXC!@" ENCRYPT, key[0:8]="!@#)(*$%" DECRYPT]
814	 *   即: D-K3 → E-K2 → D-K1
815	 */
816	fun decrypt3DesEde(encryptedBytes: ByteArray): ByteArray {
817	    require(encryptedBytes.size % DES_BLOCK_SIZE == 0) {
818	        "数据长度 ${encryptedBytes.size} 不是 ${DES_BLOCK_SIZE} 的倍数"
819	    }
820	
821	    println("   逐块 3DES 解密...")
822	    val schedule = Tripledes.tripledesKeySetup(Tripledes.KEY_24, Tripledes.DECRYPT)
823	    println("   调试: Key schedule")
824	    Tripledes.debugKeySchedule()
825	    val result = ByteArray(encryptedBytes.size)
826	    val blockCount = encryptedBytes.size / DES_BLOCK_SIZE
827	
828	    // 对第一个块使用完整调试
829	    if (blockCount > 0) {
830	        val firstBlock = encryptedBytes.copyOfRange(0, DES_BLOCK_SIZE)
831	        println("   调试: 第一个块 (${firstBlock.joinToString("") { "%02X".format(it) }})")
832	        val debugResult = Tripledes.debugTripledesCrypt(firstBlock, schedule)
833	        println("   调试: 最终输出 ${debugResult.joinToString("") { "%02X".format(it) }}")
834	        debugResult.copyInto(result, 0)
835	        // 打印关键中间值对比
836	    }
837	
838	    for (blockIdx in 1 until blockCount) {
839	        val offset = blockIdx * DES_BLOCK_SIZE
840	        val block = encryptedBytes.copyOfRange(offset, offset + DES_BLOCK_SIZE)
841	        val decrypted = Tripledes.tripledesCrypt(block, schedule)
842	
843	        // 对前 3 个块输出调试信息
844	        if (blockIdx < 3) {
845	            val inputHex = block.joinToString("") { "%02X".format(it) }
846	            val outputHex = decrypted.joinToString("") { "%02X".format(it) }
847	            println("      block${blockIdx + 1} IN: $inputHex OUT: $outputHex")
848	        }
849	
850	        decrypted.copyInto(result, offset)
851	    }
852	
853	    return result
854	}

1122	        var (s0, s1) = initialPermutation(input)
1123	
1124	        for (idx in 0 until 15) {

1144	
1145	        val keyPermC = intArrayOf(
1146	            56,48,40,32,24,16,8,0,57,49,41,33,25,17,9,1,
1147	            58,50,42,34,26,18,10,2,59,51,43,35
1148	        )
1149	        val keyPermD = intArrayOf(
1150	            62,54,46,38,30,22,14,6,61,53,45,37,29,21,13,5,
1151	            60,52,44,36,28,20,12,4,27,19,11,3
1152	        )
1153	        val keyCompression = intArrayOf(
1154	            13,16,10,23,0,4,2,27,14,5,20,9,22,18,11,3,
1155	            25,7,15,6,26,19,12,1,40,51,30,36,46,54,29,39,
1156	            50,44,32,47,43,48,38,55,33,52,45,41,49,35,28,31

1158	
1159	        val v0 = (key[0].toInt() and 0xFF) or ((key[1].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
1160	                ((key[2].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 16) or ((key[3].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 24)
1161	        val v1 = (key[4].toInt() and 0xFF) or ((key[5].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or

1167	            val bit = if (b < 32) ((v0 ushr (31 - b)) and 1).toLong()

1181	            c = ((c shl keyRndShift[i]) or (c ushr (28 - keyRndShift[i]))) and 0xFFFFFFF0L
1182	            d = ((d shl keyRndShift[i]) or (d ushr (28 - keyRndShift[i]))) and 0xFFFFFFF0L

1272	fun tryZlibDecompress(data: ByteArray): ByteArray {
1273	    // 策略 1: 标准 zlib 解压（带 zlib 头）
1274	    if (data.isNotEmpty() && (data[0].toInt() and 0xFF) == 0x78) {
1275	        try {
1276	            val result = InflaterInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(data)).use { it.readBytes() }
1277	            println("   ✅ 策略 1 (标准 zlib) 成功: ${result.size} 字节")
1278	            return result
1279	        } catch (e: Exception) {
1280	            println("   ❌ 策略 1 (标准 zlib) 失败: $e")
1281	        }
1282	    }
1283	
1284	    // 策略 2: 原始 Deflate（无 zlib 头）
1285	    try {
1286	        val inflater = Inflater(true)
1287	        val result = try {
1288	            InflaterInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(data), inflater).use { it.readBytes() }
1289	        } finally {
1290	            inflater.end()
1291	        }
1292	        println("   ✅ 策略 2 (raw deflate) 成功: ${result.size} 字节")
1293	        return result
1294	    } catch (e: Exception) {
1295	        println("   ❌ 策略 2 (raw deflate) 失败: $e")
1296	    }
1297	
1298	    // 策略 3: 寻找 zlib 头偏移
1299	    val candidateOffsets = data.withIndex()
1300	        .filter { it.value.toInt() and 0xFF == 0x78 }
1301	        .map { it.index }
1302	    if (candidateOffsets.isNotEmpty()) {
1303	        println("   尝试策略 3: 从偏移 ${candidateOffsets.joinToString()} 开始解压...")
1304	        for (offset in candidateOffsets) {
1305	            if (offset + 1 >= data.size) continue
1306	            val second = data[offset + 1].toInt() and 0xFF
1307	            val combined = (0x78 shl 8) or second
1308	            if (combined % 31 == 0) {
1309	                try {
1310	                    val result = InflaterInputStream(
1311	                        ByteArrayInputStream(data.copyOfRange(offset, data.size))
1312	                    ).use { it.readBytes() }
1313	                    println("   ✅ 策略 3 (偏移 $offset) 成功: ${result.size} 字节")
1314	                    return result
1315	                } catch (e: Exception) {
1316	                    println("   ❌ 策略 3 (偏移 $offset) 失败: $e")
1317	                }
1318	            }
1319	        }
1320	    }
1321	
1322	    throw RuntimeException("所有解压策略均失败")
1323	}

1342	/**
1343	 * 解析 QRC 格式文本
1344	 *
1345	 * QRC 格式:
1346	 *   [行起始时间,行持续时间] 单词1(起始时间,持续时间) 单词2(起始时间,持续时间) ...
1347	 *
1348	 * 示例:
1349	 *   [0,5000] 你 (0,500) 好 (500,500) 世 (1000,500) 界 (1500,500)
1350	 */
1351	fun parseQrc(content: String): List<LyricLine> {
1352	    val lyricTokenRegex = Regex("""(?<text>.*?)\((?<start>\d+),(?<duration>\d+)\)""")
1353	    val lineTimestampRegex = Regex("""^\[(\d+),(\d+)]""")
1354	
1355	    val lines = mutableListOf<LyricLine>()
1356	
1357	    for (rawLine in content.lines()) {
1358	        val line = rawLine.trim()
1359	        if (line.isEmpty()) continue
1360	
1361	        // 匹配行级时间戳
1362	        val lineStartMs = lineTimestampRegex.find(line)
1363	            ?.groups?.get(1)?.value?.toLongOrNull()
1364	        val lineDurationMs = lineTimestampRegex.find(line)
1365	            ?.groups?.get(2)?.value?.toLongOrNull()
1366	
1367	        // 移除行级时间戳
1368	        val lineContent = lineTimestampRegex.replace(line, "")
1369	        val words = mutableListOf<LyricWord>()
1370	
1371	        // 逐字匹配
1372	        for (capture in lyricTokenRegex.findAll(lineContent)) {
1373	            val text = capture.groups["text"]?.value.orEmpty()
1374	            val startMs = capture.groups["start"]?.value?.toLongOrNull() ?: continue
1375	            val durationMs = capture.groups["duration"]?.value?.toLongOrNull() ?: continue
1376	
1377	            val textClean = text.trimEnd()
1378	            words.add(
1379	                LyricWord(
1380	                    word = textClean,
1381	                    startTime = startMs,
1382	                    endTime = startMs + maxOf(1L, durationMs)
1383	                )
1384	            )
1385	        }
1386	
1387	        // 如果没有逐字时间戳，但有行级时间戳，作为整行处理
1388	        if (words.isEmpty() && lineStartMs != null) {
1389	            val fallbackText = lineContent.trim()
1390	            val normalized = fallbackText.replace(Regex("[^\\d(),]"), "")
1391	            val isTimestampToken = Regex("^\\(\\d+,\\d+\\)(?:\\(\\d+,\\d+\\))*$").matches(normalized)
1392	
1393	            if (fallbackText.isNotEmpty() && !isTimestampToken) {
1394	                val lineEnd = lineStartMs + (lineDurationMs ?: 0)
1395	                words.add(
1396	                    LyricWord(
1397	                        word = fallbackText,
1398	                        startTime = lineStartMs,
1399	                        endTime = maxOf(lineStartMs + 1, lineEnd)
1400	                    )
1401	                )
1402	            }
1403	        }
1404	
1405	        if (words.isEmpty()) continue
1406	
1407	        val lineStart = lineStartMs ?: words.first().startTime
1408	        val rawLineEnd = lineStart + (lineDurationMs ?: (words.last().endTime - lineStart))
1409	        val lineEnd = maxOf(lineStart + 1, rawLineEnd)
1410	
1411	        lines.add(
1412	            LyricLine(
1413	                startTime = lineStart,
1414	                endTime = lineEnd,
1415	                text = words.joinToString(separator = "") { it.word }.trimEnd(),
1416	                words = words
1417	            )
1418	        )
1419	    }
1420	
1421	    return lines
1422	}
